description: Practice mode, Consumer Pulse copy only (Bailiff demo, step 7): list this copy's docket entries for the order in order (order, refusal, warning, appeal, ruling, second refusal, enforcement) and verify the demo Bailiff enforcement receipt. Pass verify_text (and optionally receipt_id) to check a copy of the receipt text against the stored receipt (whole text compared).

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of your practice copy (returned by atlas.enter_demo). Optional when you have one copy.
